customers.description: One record per synthetic customer. Demographic/risk attributes only -- no names, addresses, or other sensitive PII.

created_at.description: Date the customer record was created.

credit_score_band.description: Coarse credit score bracket, statistically correlated with risk_segment.

risk_segment.description: Underwriting risk tier. Drives interest rate range and loan/payment outcome probabilities during generation.

loans.description: One record per loan. Every loan references an existing customer_id.

principal_amount.description: Original loan principal, in dollars. Always positive.

interest_rate.description: Descriptive metadata only. NOT used in scheduled_payment_amount or any balance calculation in the MVP.

loan_status.description: ACTIVE: still within its term. CLOSED: term elapsed, PAID payments reconcile to principal within $0.01. DEFAULTED: payment history ends in a LATE/MISSED payment; no further payments generated.

scheduled_payment_amount.description: principal_amount / term_months, rounded to 2 decimals. This is also amount_due on every payment for this loan.

payments.description: One record per due date. Every payment references an existing loan_id.

payment_date.description: Date the payment was actually made. Null for SCHEDULED and MISSED payments.

amount_due.description: Always equal to the parent loan's scheduled_payment_amount.

amount_paid.description: Amount actually paid. > 0 for PAID and LATE; == 0 for SCHEDULED, MISSED, and FAILED.

payment_status.description: PAID: on/before due_date, amount_paid > 0 -- counted as successful in the MVP balance calculation. LATE: after due_date, amount_paid > 0 -- money was eventually received, but excluded from the MVP balance calculation as a deliberate simplification (see context/business_rules.json). MISSED: never paid, amount_paid == 0. FAILED: an attempted payment that did not succeed, amount_paid == 0. SCHEDULED: not yet due, amount_paid == 0.

payment_method.description: How the payment was made or attempted.

portfolio_summary.description: Single aggregate object (not an array) produced by src/transform.py from loans.json and payments.json.

as_of_date.description: The business date this summary represents.

successful_payment_count.description: Number of payments with payment_status in business_rules.successful_payment_statuses (PAID only, for the MVP).

total_original_principal.description: Sum of principal_amount across all loans.

total_successful_payments.description: Sum of amount_paid across successful payments only.

total_outstanding_balance.description: total_original_principal - total_successful_payments. Answers 'what is today's total outstanding loan balance?'
